query: How complete is the metadata for our Finance domain?
expected_behavior: Scopes every query to the Finance domain instead of the whole catalog
Reports classified and governed classification coverage as two separate numbers
Marks governed coverage as not measured when no enforcement layer is named
Distinguishes not-measured from zero for any Cloud-only dimension on an OSS instance
Validates a filter with list-filters or --dry-run before reporting a dimension as 0%
Produces a report using the audit-report template with a grade and a ranked fix list
